newsitem.title: USA: Adaptec chairman to retire August 21.
newsitem.headline: Adaptec chairman to retire August 21.

text.p: Adaptec Inc said Thursday its chairman, John Adler, planned to retire on August 21.
"Working at Adaptec has been one of the most exciting and rewarding periods of my life," Adler said in a statement.
"The company is in excellent shape. It was a great pleasure working with the board of directors, and I have confidence that the management team will continue to be very successful," he said.
Adler joined Adaptec as president in 1985, was named chief executive officer in 1986, and chairman of the board in 1990. He served as president and chief executive until July 1995.
The company makes computer subsystems, software and chips that accelerate the movement of data.
